newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Tatneft to split shares 100 to one-dealer.
newsitem.headline: Russian Tatneft to split shares 100 to one-dealer.

text.p: The board of directors of Russian oil company Tatneft TATN.RTS will propose a 100 to one share split at the annual meeting on June 27, a Tatneft market-maker said on Thursday.
Sergei Yurida, head of trading at Solid, a Tatneft market maker, said the move is aimed at increasing liquidity and would not be a new issue or authorisation of new shares.
He said dividends, if approved, would be paid to shareholders registered as of May 27.
He also said shareholders at the annual meeting would vote whether to renew Price Waterhouse's contract as foreign financial auditor.

Tatneft American Depositary Receipts trading in Berlin had risen to 143.00 marks at 1500 GMT from 140.00 marks on Wednesday and Tatneft shares on the Russian Trading System closed at $86.00 after $85.00.
